marauder.pitch: Melé pesado. Sable a dos manos o doble sable rojo, armadura recia, furia. Es la silueta más ancha de las tres.
marauder.subject: imposing Sith warrior juggernaut, broad heavy build, heavy layered crimson-and-black plate armor with tall spiked pauldrons and a segmented gorget, battle-scarred bare forearms, tattered dark war-skirt over greaves, heavy armored boots, wielding a two-handed red lightsaber held low across the body, shaven scarred head with ritual burn marks, jaw set in contempt, aggressive grounded wide stance
marauder.notes: Silueta más ancha que alta — las hombreras definen el personaje. Fondo verde porque el carmesí domina el sprite.

states.attack: mid overhead two-handed saber swing, both arms extended, weight thrown forward onto the front foot, snarling open-mouthed, war-skirt flaring back
states.hurt: recoiling flinch with guard broken, saber arm swung wide, head snapped back, one step retreating
states.down: down on one knee, saber stabbed blade-first into the ground as a crutch, head bowed, shoulders heaving

inquisitor.pitch: Control y Fuerza. Túnica, rayos, sable fino al cinto. Pose de canalización en ataque.
inquisitor.subject: gaunt Sith sorcerer, tall and thin, flowing black-and-violet hooded robes with gilt trim and long trailing sleeves, high collar, pale hollow-cheeked face half-shadowed by the hood, sunken eyes ringed in dark-side corruption veins, violet force-lightning crackling around raised skeletal fingers, a single thin red lightsaber hilt clipped at the hip, bare feet under the hem, poised upright stance
inquisitor.notes: La luz del rayo violeta es la única fuente cálida del sprite — que se refleje en la cara y el borde de la túnica.

states.attack: both hands thrust forward in a channeling pose, arcs of violet force lightning erupting from the fingertips, robes and sleeves blown backward, head tilted down with eyes blazing
states.hurt: staggering back, hood falling off the shoulders, robe whipping sideways, one arm raised in a broken ward
states.down: collapsed to both knees, robes pooled on the ground, one hand splayed flat for support, hood fully off

assassin.pitch: Sigilo y crítico. Doble sable, silueta esbelta, capucha que oculta el rostro.
assassin.subject: lithe hooded Sith assassin, slim athletic build, matte-black wrapped armor with segmented plates and a long torn cloak, face fully shadowed inside the hood with only two faint red eye-glints visible, forearm wraps and soft-soled boots, holding a double-bladed red lightsaber angled across the body, coiled low predatory stance ready to spring
assassin.notes: Todo negro sobre negro: la legibilidad viene del filo rojo y del borde de luz superior-izquierda. Nada de detalle dentro de la capucha.

states.attack: mid-lunge spinning double-saber strike, both blades arcing in a bright crossing sweep, cloak flaring wide behind, body low and extended
states.hurt: twisting away from the blow, cloak flaring, off-balance on one foot, hood half torn back
states.down: crumpled sideways on the ground, double-bladed saber fallen and deactivated beside the hand, hood off revealing a pale scarred face
